data.name: Jayanto
data.gender_notes: Jayanto is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jayanto is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jayanta', which means 'conqueror' or 'victorious'. It is a name that signifies power, triumph, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Jayanto is the name of various gods and warriors who embodied these qualities. The name Jayanto carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayanto usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with victory and courage.
data.etymology: Jayanto belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayanto total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
